free_tier.stated: USD 25.20/year for KVM VPS Starter in Chicago with coupon 10THVPS: 1 vCPU, 1 GB RAM, 10 GB SSD, 250 GB monthly bandwidth, 1 IPv4. KVM VPS 1 is USD 50.40/year for 2 vCPU, 2 GB, 20 GB and 500 GB; KVM VPS 2 is USD 86.40/year for 3 vCPU, 4 GB, 40 GB and 1 TB. The same sale prices shared hosting from USD 2.40/year for 1 GB of SSD and 50 GB of monthly bandwidth, and premium shared hosting from USD 4.32/year. All coupons are recurring for as long as the account renews annually, and every discount applies to annual plans only.

egress.terms: 250 GB a month on the Starter VPS, 500 GB on VPS 1 and 1 TB on VPS 2; no overage price and no post-allowance throttle stated

interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
tooling: the vendor sells cPanel, DirectAdmin and WHMCS licences alongside the plans and names a Blesta owned licence in the same sale; no API or CLI is documented for the VPS line on either page read
chaining: USD 25.20/year is USD 2.10/month for a 1 GB machine with 250 GB of monthly transfer, which is the cheapest annual VPS, and the same invoice can carry a mailbox and a small site; 250 GB a month is too little for a crawler, so the job it fits is a cron box, a monitor or a jump host

limits.value: 250 GB a month on the Starter VPS is the smallest allowance and the one that binds first by a wide margin: it is about 0.77 Mbit/s sustained, so the counter is the wall and the port is irrelevant. The shared plans carry 50 GB to 200 GB a month. No overage price and no post-allowance throttle are stated.
